Five RPC handlers can transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured webhook URLs: CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, and CreateMemoComment.

`webhook.PostAsync` is the single function where all paths converge before the actual HTTP delivery. `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` handles Create, Update, and Delete, but `CreateMemoComment` bypasses it and calls `webhook.PostAsync` directly.

`SetMemoAttachments` and `SetMemoRelations` route through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`. The convergence function is `PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`.

`ValidateURL` during `CreateUserWebhook` performs a DNS lookup, yet this occurs at configuration time and does not constitute outbound HTTP to the user URL. SSO sign-in with an identity provider would reach admin-configured OAuth endpoints, but those paths diverge from the webhook convergence point.

h06.
`CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `CreateMemoComment`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`; `webhook.PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

Those RPC handlers (in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`, `memo_attachment_service.go`, `memo_relation_service.go`) dispatch memo webhooks. Created/updated/deleted go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comment-created posts on its own. Every path then calls `PostAsync`, which queues the request before `Post` performs the HTTP delivery to the user’s webhook URL.
